audience: online shops that ship parcels with GHTK

useCases.title: Check the status of an order
useCases.text: Read the status, fees, pickup and delivery dates and COD amount of an order, by GHTK label or your own code.

useCases.title: Quote a shipping fee for a route
useCases.text: Check the delivery address against GHTK's address data. Then quote the shipping and insurance fee for the route and weight.

useCases.title: Find pickup addresses and order solutions
useCases.text: List the pickup addresses saved in the shop and the solutions you can attach to an order.

useCases.title: Find warehouse products for an order
useCases.text: Search the shop's product list by name to get the product codes for an order.

useCases.title: Create an order and cancel it before pickup
useCases.text: Create a shipping order. GHTK schedules a pickup and charges the fee. Cancel the order only before the parcel is picked up.
